and Diu

CORAM DR. NEELA GOKHALE, J.
DATED: 24TH NOVEMBER 2025
PC:-
1.  After some arguments, when I was not inclined to
grant the relief, Mr. Jaisur Hardikkumar, learned counsel for
the Applicant, on instructions, sought permission to withdraw
the present Bail Application with a liberty to file a fre sh Bail
Application  after  one  year,  if  the  trial  does  not  prog ress
substantially.
2.  Permission  to  withdraw  is  granted  with  liberty  as
prayed.
Page 1 of 2
24th  November 2025

Prasad Rajput
      (P .A.)                                                                                                         47_BA_2346_2025.doc
3.
  Bail Application is disposed of as withdrawn. 
4.  The learned Trial Court is requested to expedite
the trial and conclude the same within a period of one year
from the date on which this order is placed before it. 
 (DR. NEELA GOKHALE, J)
Page 2 of 2
24th  November 2025
